'''Rosso''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] long before the planet's rediscovery during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Rosso was memorialized by a shrine in the area later known as the [[Nightmare Lands]].
